name: sol8-tab-overflow-cue
goal: Keep overflowing entity sections visibly discoverable in mobile and desktop captures.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Content history-mobile still begins inside Used In. Overflow needs a persistent visible cue when native scrollbars are hidden or faded.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The component catalog asserted scrollbar CSS values without requiring visible guidance. Extend its existing overflow matrix and the default Tabs fixture; keep case counts stable.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 50eda3330d, five standard cases fail for a missing persistent overflow cue; four non-overflow cases pass. The original captures remain in tabcue-red.json.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 373f0e7407 adds persistent guidance next to overflowing sections and observes tab widths. Existing focus, selection and horizontal scrollbar behavior are preserved.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 52f04a31cc passes all nine unchanged cases at 373f0e7407, paired with a1f46077d7 at 50eda3330d. Inspected every viewport image, including cue placement.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
